scope: read-only audit of text rendering size/strategy selection and subpixel AA

font_size_to_scale.detail: font_scale = ceil(text_size/7) clamped 1..8; font_scale_from_px = ceil(fontPx/7) clamped 1..8

glyph_strategy.detail: draw_glyphs selects the 12x14 coverage atlas for all scales (SMOOTH_MIN_SCALE=1 at src/font.rs:139); each output pixel uses 6x6 grayscale sub-samples, no RGB/LCD subpixel filtering

host_text_spans.detail: system-font layer carries fontPx and baseline; no subpixel/antialias strategy hint is emitted

flutter_authority.topic: subpixel text path exists and is golden-tested

flutter_authority.detail: Subpixel, SubpixelScaled, SubpixelScaledTranslated validate fractional-x glyph edges
DlPaint anti_alias defaults are part of the display-list contract

gaps.title: no size-dependent text AA strategy
gaps.evidence: Opurom uses one 6x6 grayscale coverage kernel for every scale (src/raster.rs:2544,2593); Flutter exposes a distinct subpixel text path and goldens (impeller/display_list/testing/render_text_in_canvas.cc:26-29, dl_golden_unittests.cc:534-552).
gaps.risk: small-body text may differ in effective stem weight and edge colour versus Flutter; no pixel parity claim can be made.
gaps.recommendation: First add an opt-in renderQuality.textAa strategy with grayscale default; do not change default goldens. Requires a separate IR proposal before adding any wire field.

gaps.title: no LCD/RGB subpixel filter or fractional origin
gaps.evidence: raster.rs smooth_coverage samples 6x6 scalar coverage and writes one alpha (src/raster.rs:2626-2673); Flutter subpixel tests set SkFont::setSubpixel and validate fractional-x offsets (render_text_in_canvas.cc:26-29, aiks_dl_text_unittests.cc:353).
gaps.risk: fractional-x text positions quantize to integer output pixels, so per-channel colour fringing behaviour cannot match Flutter.
gaps.recommendation: Architecture review needed: fractional glyph origin and RGB coverage would require extending LaidOut/IR metrics and potentially the display-list command shape; keep blocked until proposal is accepted.

gaps.title: Skia source line-level cross-check unavailable
gaps.evidence: Skia submodule is absent in flutter-golden; DEPS pins revision 0e5d8d1be81b22f5529a41cf4810dd89b63527ba at DEPS:18,505.
gaps.risk: SkFont/SkRasterPipeline exact thresholds and LCD formula cannot be cited with file:line yet.
gaps.recommendation: When Skia checkout is available, re-run this audit against the pinned revision; until then rely on Impeller/framework goldens above and mark Skia-only gaps as unresolved.

next_action: P1 text rendering: prepare opt-in text AA strategy proposal (no IR change in this commit); then continue with quantised glyph fractional-origin risk assessment.
